reasoning: Two prior batches (pivot + R2) already proposed ALL FOUR valid single-op edits on parent 2 (the reaction-diffusion Okuda route), but no results have landed (header still shows round 3 / 0 runs / 0% coverage), so building further on parent 2 is blocked until data returns. To grow the map independent of that, this batch opens the UNMAPPED parent-3 family = 'uniform inflation' (vesicle_growth + divide_3d + shape_energy_3d + reconnect_t1_3d), the pure MECHANICAL-growth route that COMPLEMENTS parent 2's RD route: together they answer whether a grown morphology needs Turing reaction-diffusion (chi) or just mechanical growth+division. The central falsifiable question is whether ANY single edit breaks 'uniform inflation (no patterning)' into a patterned protrusion. s1 swaps shape_energy to the monolayer implementation (the shell-buckling / undulation route, Okuda Fig 7) betting AGAINST the type system's 'no patterning' label; s2 removes the growth driver to confirm vesicle_growth is necessary for the inflation and to record the family's first solo effect; s3 removes topology relief (reconnect_t1_3d) to test whether T1 transitions matter under isotropic growth. Baseline buffer-saturation risk (growth+division stack) is noted but lower than parent 2's triple-growth stack that saturated in R2, and two of three edits remove ops so they stay safe even if the control saturates.
